description: The Meter Reading Log keeps the full history of readings for one meter - electricity, water, gas, equipment run hours, copier page counts or a vehicle odometer - in a single field on the record. Every time someone records a reading, the control works out how much was used since the previous reading and the usage per day, and it flags readings that look wrong or unusual.
features: Edit and delete dated readings (actual, estimated, customer, new meter)
Automatic usage and per-day rate per interval
Validation against earlier and later readings
High/low usage anomaly flags against the average
Period and type filters, KPI strip
A keyboard-accessible usage chart with average line
